card.name: Interacting drug effects on another drug
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction sentences where one drug acts on another, such as verbs like increases, reduced, slows, and the next slot where the second drug is named. It also fires inside the second drug's name.

modes.label: Effect verbs and links
modes.description: Verbs or small words right after the acting drug, just before the affected drug or its level is named.
modes.example: Phenytoin Phenytoin increases<< the>>ophylline clearance by increasing micros

modes.label: Inside partner drug names
modes.description: Partway through the name of the second drug in an interaction pair.
modes.example: For some antiretroviral drugs, such as atazanavir and<< n>>elfinavir, decreased serum levels

modes.label: Mutual action outside drugs
modes.description: Verbs or nouns where one thing acts on or meshes with a paired thing.
modes.example: every time the problem tooth tries to mesh with teeth on the mating<< gear>>

card.writes: It pushes toward words about a partner or counterpart, meaning the other party in an interaction.
card.plain: It marks spots in interaction text where one drug is about to be linked to the other drug it affects.
